==Usage instructions==
To be used when citing short comics from ''[[Star Wars: The Official Magazine]]''.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>UKFanCite|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''ARTICLE NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

*'''Note''': Formatted name is ''only'' needed when the episode name includes either italicization, or intentional parentheses. Otherwise, it should be excluded, as parenthetical descriptors are natively hidden.

*{{UKFanCite|5|Second Trooper|Second Trooper: Memoirs of Mon Mothma}}
*{{UKFanCite|34|Goldenrod! Top Ten Star Wars Droids|Goldenrod! Top Ten ''Star Wars'' Droids}}

[[Category:Magazine citation templates]]</noinclude>
